results.task_description: Resolve the user's area input (city name, neighbourhood, postcode, free text) into coordinates and/or a bounding box or polygon that downstream POI search can consume.

checked_claims.claim: Endpoint is GET https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search
checked_claims.note: The Search docs state the API format is `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?<params>`.

checked_claims.claim: Accepts either q= free-form query or structured params including city, state, country, postalcode
checked_claims.note: Docs list a free-form `q` parameter and a structured form with amenity, street, city, county, state, country, postalcode.

checked_claims.claim: format supports jsonv2 and geojson
checked_claims.note: format accepts one of xml, json, jsonv2, geojson, geocodejson, with jsonv2 the default.

checked_claims.claim: addressdetails=1 returns an address breakdown
checked_claims.note: Docs: 'When set to 1, include a breakdown of the address into elements.'

checked_claims.claim: polygon_geojson=1 returns the area polygon
checked_claims.note: Polygon output section documents polygon_geojson (0 or 1) adding the full geometry of the place as GeoJSON.

checked_claims.claim: countrycodes= acts as a hard country filter
checked_claims.note: Docs explicitly call countrycodes a 'hard filter' that should be preferred over the fuzzy structured 'country' parameter.

checked_claims.claim: limit can be up to 40
checked_claims.note: Docs: limit 'Cannot be more than 40' (default 10).

checked_claims.claim: Each result carries lat, lon and a boundingbox array
checked_claims.note: The Search page's parameter documentation and truncated example do not show result fields; the Place Output Formats page was not fetched.

checked_claims.claim: Free and no API key required
checked_claims.note: Neither the Search docs nor the usage policy mentions pricing or the absence of an API key (only an optional `email` parameter for large request volumes).

checked_claims.claim: Public instance has a hard cap of 1 request/second
checked_claims.note: Usage policy: 'No heavy uses (an absolute maximum of 1 request per second).'

checked_claims.claim: Mandatory identifying User-Agent/Referer
checked_claims.note: Policy requires a valid HTTP Referer or User-Agent identifying the application; stock library User-Agents are not acceptable.

checked_claims.claim: Mandatory ODbL attribution
checked_claims.note: Policy requires clearly displaying attribution and notes data is provided under the ODbL share-alike licence.

checked_claims.claim: Mandatory client-side caching
checked_claims.note: Policy states results 'must be cached' on your side for bulk tasks and urges caching/proxying for apps, though the strict 'must' is stated in the bulk-geocoding section.

checked_claims.claim: Long-running or periodic scripts capped at 4 requests/minute, single thread, single machine
checked_claims.note: Bulk Geocoding rules: single thread, 1 machine only, and scripts running longer than a day or at regular intervals restricted to 4 requests per minute.

checked_claims.claim: 'Systematic queries' and 'downloading all POIs in an area' are explicitly forbidden and grounds for a ban
checked_claims.note: Unacceptable Use lists 'Systematic queries ... and downloading all POIs in an area' among uses that are 'strictly forbidden and will get you banned'.

checked_claims.claim: Reselling geocoding results is prohibited
checked_claims.note: Unacceptable Use includes 'Reselling of geocoding results'; geocoding-primary services must run their own instance.

checked_claims.claim: Commercial use is told to self-host or use a commercial provider
checked_claims.note: Policy warns commercial applications about access withdrawal and points to third-party providers or installing your own instance.

results.summary: Nearly all checkable claims about the /search endpoint parameters (q, structured fields, format, addressdetails, polygon_geojson, countrycodes, limit≤40) and the public instance's usage policy (1 req/s, User-Agent/Referer, ODbL attribution, caching, 4 req/min for long-running scripts, forbidden systematic queries and reselling) are directly confirmed by the fetched pages. Two smaller claims are unverified here: that results include lat, lon and a boundingbox array (the Output Formats page was not fetched) and that the service is 'free and no key', which neither fetched page states. No claim is contradicted.
